rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when copying a person's speech, behaviour, or style.

example.english: I usually emulate the way my mother speaks.
example.traditional: 我平時都係模仿阿媽講嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 si4 dou1 hai6 mou4 fong2 aa3 maa1 gong2 je5

rows.note: Use this for software or hardware made to act like another program or device, rather than for copying a person.

example.english: This program can emulate an old game console.
example.traditional: 呢個程式可以模擬舊式遊戲機。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 ho2 ji5 mou4 ji5 gau6 sik1 jau4 hei3 gei1
